alternatives.name: AgentsView
alternatives.why_not_default: Native archive refresh retained 17 selected session identities, but observation is a scoped snapshot requiring explicit refresh; continuous service telemetry and automatic archive discovery are not established.

alternatives.name: otel-tui
alternatives.why_not_default: The bounded-history-and-traces decision records a synthetic loopback terminal trace. It does not establish production trace completeness or reconciled native usage.

alternatives.name: Claude HUD
alternatives.why_not_default: Recorded native terminal observations establish rendered model, project, context and usage fields. This client-specific display does not provide cross-client service observation, and every statistic and billing reconciliation remain unqualified.

alternatives.name: OpenLIT
alternatives.why_not_default: No installation, hook invocation or telemetry delivery was executed. Its additional transcript instrumentation requires privacy and counter reconciliation and could duplicate collection.

alternatives.name: ntfy
alternatives.why_not_default: Local firing/resolved feed delivery passed, but notification delivery complements collection and accounting. Corrected formatting has renderer replay evidence without a subsequent production webhook observation.

alternatives.name: Alertmanager
alternatives.why_not_default: The native local alert route was exercised using a deliberately unavailable loopback fixture. Routing complements the selected observation pipeline; external paging and unattended remediation were not accepted.

alternatives.name: SGLang
alternatives.why_not_default: Serving commands are prospective. No matched task execution, target-hardware compatibility or measured prefix-cache benefit establishes a better optional route.

alternatives.name: llama.cpp optional local inference
alternatives.why_not_default: One pinned partial-offload repair passed independent review and 12 original tests, but generation took 179.191 seconds near its 180-second cap. There is no matched baseline model trial, representative workload qualification or recovery acceptance supporting a default inference route.

alternatives.name: Loki
alternatives.why_not_default: Native sanitized-log ingestion and receipt queries are established, with bounded restart evidence. It remains a useful supporting sink, but does not replace metrics reconciliation or rendered observation; removed payloads cannot be reconstructed and no trace database was accepted.

alternatives.name: Phoenix
alternatives.why_not_default: Although marked adopted in the packet, retained evidence is source review: launch is prospective, no application was instrumented and no judge-model calls ran. Trace capture privacy and actual integration remain unqualified.

limits: This verdict reviews retained public evidence; no new native client, backend, browser or GPU execution was performed.
Private returned-output archives and screenshots were not inspected; their observations are available through sanitized retained records.
Upstream metadata was treated as packet context and was not independently refreshed.
open_gaps: Privacy acceptance covers tested fields and trusted instrumentation. Its direct canary was synthetic; arbitrary-content DLP is not established.
The native SDK turn histogram remained absent. Imported completed-receipt summaries are a separate accounting path, not fresh model execution.
Process startup events, missing historical attribution and cache-category semantics prevent exact whole-account billing or causal lifetime savings claims.
Traces are disabled. Phoenix and OpenLIT lack executed trace-quality and privacy comparisons against the current pipeline.
Single-host restart checks do not establish reboot persistence, high availability, full-disk recovery or extended-outage delivery.
Optional inference is qualified only for the recorded llama.cpp repair trial; broader workloads, concurrency and host portability remain open.

arms: Retained Collector Contrib, Prometheus and Grafana pipeline using native client results as the usage oracle.
One isolated candidate replacement using the same native task and privacy probes, without simultaneous duplicate capture.
For optional inference, the pinned llama.cpp repair route versus one candidate route on the same frozen task and original oracle.
overturn_protocol.metric: Require correct fixture output, agreement with native usage categories, preserved writer identity and unknown usage, absence of tested forbidden content, no duplicate counting, and observed delivery/recovery. Compare actual latency and resource use. Optional inference must pass the frozen original oracle and resource/deadline contract. Local test success alone cannot promote a candidate.

overturn_when: Change the verdict when an executed comparison using fixtures/observability-check.json and the identity/unknown-usage contracts in tests/test_observability.py shows a candidate closes a concrete observation gap while preserving privacy, usage fidelity and recovery without duplicate capture. Promote an optional inference route only after an executed comparison against blueprints/convergence-practice/gpu-inference/experiment.json demonstrates task correctness and acceptable measured latency/resources.
why_selected: Select Collector Contrib, Prometheus and Grafana as complementary collection, metrics and presentation components. observability/receipt.json records actual native Codex/Claude task execution, collected usage, loopback service queries and rendered observation; its privacy check is explicitly a synthetic canary through native exporters. docs/native-telemetry-resolution.md records a later real Claude task whose four usage categories matched Prometheus and appeared in Grafana. docs/dashboard-rendered-acceptance.md records rendered panels checked against native commands and APIs, with project-local panels identified as integration work. These observations best support the required single privacy-filtered local pipeline. Supporting log/alert components remain conditional, and optional inference retains its separate workload gate.
